observations.runtime_ui: Accessibility inspection of the already-open Disk Utility observed View, separate add/delete Volume buttons, First Aid, Partition, Erase, Restore, Unmount and Info. Restore, Unmount and delete were disabled for the selected startup snapshot. No disk-changing action was invoked.

limitations: Resource-only analysis; no executable identity or decompilation claimed.
Compiled UI graph has partial coverage for unrecognized fields and hierarchy.
Static selector names do not prove implementation or runtime behavior.
Pixel geometry, animations and arbitrary disk operations were not measured.
